Name: Bullet
Description: Click to fire {count} missile(s) at the cursor for {value} damage

Name: Melee
Description: Click to slash in front of you for {value} damage (reach {radius})

Name: Morph
Description: Hold on an enemy and release: a slow-motion shot consumes it and you become it for {duration}s (attacks x{value})

Name: Heal
Description: Click for a healing ring (radius {radius}) that heals {value} HP/s for {duration}s

Name: Duplicate
Description: Click to summon {count} clone(s) for {duration}s that shoot for {value} damage

Name: Devour
Description: Click for an expanding dome (radius {radius}) that eats enemies and bullets for {value}/tick. Costs {hpcost} HP

Name: Refresh
Description: Click to refill your dice rolls to full and slow time for {duration}s (one use)

Name: Meteor
Description: Click to call {count} meteors around the cursor, {value} damage in radius {radius}

Name: Frost Nova
Description: Click to freeze enemies within {radius} for {duration}s and deal {value} damage

Name: Magnet
Description: Click to pull every pickup on the map to you (one use)

Name: Aegis
Description: Click to become invulnerable for {duration}s with an aura dealing {value} damage

Name: Gold Rush
Description: Click: every kill drops gold for {duration}s (one use)
